_description: EB 5D leave-two-out (iJKOnet paper, Persiianov et al., 2026, Table 1). Hold out t1 and t3, train on t0/t2/t4. PCA dim 5, normalized space, evaluation metric is W2 distance to held-out marginals. The canonical config is eb_ijko.json (now includes consistency_loss=imf, which beat the meanflow default in 5-seed validation). This file is documentation only and is not loaded by train.py.
